stem.text: Each of the compounds below is treated separately with an excess of $\text{NaBH}_4$.
The product of each reaction is then heated with an excess of concentrated $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$.
Which compounds give **only one** final product with the molecular formula $\text{C}_7\text{H}_{10}$?

items.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a C=O group on one ring carbon (O drawn to the right) and a CHO group on another ring carbon (O and H drawn below).
Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a C=O group on the top ring carbon (O drawn above) and a CHO group on the bottom ring carbon (O and H drawn below).
